name: Mariangela Scotto di Carlo
headline: UX/UI Designer
major: Bachelor in Psychology and M.Sc. in Ergonomics - Human Factors Engineering
summary:
Hi there! 
I’m a UX/UI Designer with a unique mix of psychology, design, and research expertise, passionate about creating accessible, delightful, and user-centered experiences. I have extensive experience leading feature development, from user research and concept generation to high-fidelity prototypes, usability testing, and other validation methods. A true Figma geek and highly skilled in Adobe’s graphic design and animation tools, I especially love working in the healthcare and healthtech space, but I’m excited to explore other fields as well. I’m dedicated, curious, and always eager to learn and grow with a dynamic team to build impactful products!

positions.title: UI/UX Designer
positions.description: QuickBird Medical develops medical software and digital health applications (DiGA) for customers in the health space. We build digital therapeutics (DTx) for pharmaceutical companies, digital health startups and other institutions on a contract basis.

positions.title: Senior UX/UI Designer
positions.description:

positions.title: UX/UI Designer
